# Upstream ontology snapshots

These MIT-licensed RCOnt v2.0.0 and GMOnt v1.0.0 schemas are pinned compatibility
fixtures. manifest.json records their source repositories, commits and local SHA-256
hashes. Original namespaces are retained. The files are not loaded automatically by
the runtime. Upstream repositories remain authoritative; update fixtures alongside
the compatibility tests. See LICENSE for retained attribution.
